mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 4 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 13, low 2.

Switzerland's intelligence service warned that a wave of foreign espionage is underway, with increased activity from Russia, China and Iran, according to director Serge Bavaud.

Kosovo will face Israel in a Euro-qualifier, but 18-year-old striker Enis Rexhepi remains out of the 23-man squad because his FIFA paperwork has not been completed.

SpaceX launched its Starship vehicle into orbit from Texas, but the planned booster-catch maneuver failed, leaving the booster unrecovered.

Macedonian Prime Minister Hristijan Mickoski said the country's industrial output is growing, countering opposition claims that the economy is heading toward a downturn.

Albanian Democratic Party leader Sali Berisha announced he is ready to cooperate with any force, including Mayor Erion Veliaj, to oust Prime Minister Edi Rama from power.
